title: Whipped Feta Dip
description: Learn how to make whipped feta into a creamy dip that guests will love. This garlic and herb whipped feta is easy to make in your food processor.

steps.text: Combine feta cheese, yogurt, oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and garlic in a food processor and mix until well blended and smooth. Add mint, basil, and pepper and pulse to combine.

video.description: Whipped feta is a TikTok trend that lives up to the hype! This video shows you how to prepare an easy recipe that transforms creamy feta cheese into a luscious dip with the addition of Greek yogurt, garlic, lemon, and fresh herbs. The best part? It all comes together in minutes – simply combine the ingredients in a food processor and whip until smooth. With a flavor profile similar to that of a tzatziki, this whipped feta dip can be served with just about anything. It makes a great compliment to your next charcuterie board, and it’s also the perfect accompaniment to grilled lamb or steak, kabobs, or sandwiches.
